evidence: Changes core script execution and transaction primitive data structures in src/script/script.h, src/script/interpreter.cpp, and src/primitives/transaction.h.
rationale: Substantially reduces memory overhead and DoS attack surface during transaction handling and validation. As stated in the PR description, 'CScriptWitness shrinks from 24 to 8 bytes, and CTxIn from 112 to 96 bytes. Worst-case allocated size for transactions kept in memory drops from roughly 28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU.'
